decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +1.4% and S&P 500 +1.6% confirm a broad risk-on day. With 3 open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, we filled all three with multi-signal-confirmed momentum names (OUST, AAPL, KD) rather than sitting on idle cash, per the strategy memory's risk-on deployment rule.

market_education.summary_en: Equities rallied broadly today, with the NASDAQ up 1.4% and the S&P 500 up 1.6%, reflecting improved risk appetite across sectors. Breadth was strong, with momentum names showing MACD bullish crossovers and volume surges, a sign institutional buyers were participating rather than just retail traders chasing price. This kind of broad-based, high-volume advance is typically read as confirmation of a genuine risk-on shift rather than a one-day bounce.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍造好，納指升1.4%，標普500指數升1.6%，反映市場風險胃納明顯改善。市場參與度廣泛，多隻具動力的股份出現MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大，顯示機構投資者積極入市，而非單純散戶追價。這種成交量放大、普遍上揚的格局，一般被視為風險偏好真正轉強的確認信號，而非單日反彈。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-on' day is when investors broadly shift money into stocks and away from safer assets because they feel more confident about the economy or markets. Today's broad gains across the NASDAQ and S&P 500, combined with volume surges in individual stocks, signaled that confidence — which is why we deployed available cash into confirmed momentum names instead of waiting.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）日是指投資者普遍將資金轉向股票等風險資產，而減少持有現金或債券等避險資產，反映對經濟或市場較有信心。今日納指及標普500普遍上揚，加上個股成交量放大，正正反映這種信心，所以我們將可動用現金投入已獲多重訊號確認的動力股，而非持續持現金觀望。
